## What a workflow is

[Getting Started with Claude AI](../index.qmd) explains what Claude Code is, and [Claude Code for Research and Project Management](../use-cases.qmd) shows the kinds of work it helps with. This section goes one level deeper: each page is a single, concrete workflow you run from start to finish.

Three things hold across all of them:

- **You own the specification.** Claude does not decide what to analyze or how to present it. You set the goal; it handles the execution.
- **The value is in the loop.** Because Claude Code runs tools on your computer, it writes, runs, reads the result, and fixes what broke, so you react to the outcome, not to every step.
- **Nothing lands on the first try.** The rhythm is always ask, review, adjust, repeat.

Throughout, share **structure and code, never raw data**. See [Prompt safely](../use-cases.qmd#prompt-safely).
